name: Ecuadorian Andes
about: Dry season Jun–Sep has the clearest volcano views and safest climbing conditions; cloud-forest birding on both Andean slopes stays excellent nearly year-round, regardless of season.
overview: Ecuador's high-altitude capital and two very different headline draws around it — volcano climbing and trekking south to Cotopaxi and Chimborazo, and some of the best cloud-forest birding on Earth on both Andean slopes.
costOverview: Quito itself is one of the cheapest capital cities in South America to eat and get around in — day tours to Cotopaxi and Quilotoa, and multi-day birding-lodge stays, are the main real expense.
